These individuals were initially identified due to discrepancies reported during the Special Intensive Revision process. However, follow-up house visits successfully registered many eligible voters. This incident has raised concerns over the reliability of the Election Commission's ECINet software, prompting criticism from opposition parties about electoral registration procedures and centralization.

title: Tata Sons tells Noel Tata Chandrasekaran reappointment was legally valid: Report
description: Tata Sons has asserted the legal validity of N Chandrasekaran's reappointment as chairman. The company cited legal opinions supporting the decision against the Tata Trusts' allegations of governance breaches. A pending vote on his directorship is crucial for his continuation in the role. Complications arise as regulatory restrictions limit the Sir Ratan Tata Trust's voting decisions.

title: Xi Jinping tests Donald Trump with 'Thucydides Trap'
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping asserted that the US and China should work together to avoid conflict. He emphasized that China's rise does not have to threaten the United States' position. Despite past confrontational rhetoric, President Trump responded positively, highlighting their relationship. Critics remain skeptical, arguing that China's military expansion poses significant risks. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stressed the importance of engaging with China amidst these challenges.

title: Russell Wilson and Ciara’s $3M hospital donation and $1.75M school gift
description: Russell Wilson and Ciara have spent more than a decade using their Why Not You Foundation to support children through education, health care and hunger programs. Their work includes a $1.75 million school investment, a $3 million hospital gift, a $2 million donation in Mexico and $500,000 for Atlanta food programs, along with wider fundraising and youth programs.

Uzbekistan and Germany lead the open section with 14 points. In the women’s event, Savitha Shri extended her winning streak to seven, rescuing India against Kazakhstan and keeping their title hopes alive.

title: SC flags ‘false’ POCSO cases in marital disputes, bars immediate arrest of accused parent
description: The Supreme Court has stressed the need for cautious evaluations prior to immediate arrests under the POCSO Act. They underscored the crucial role of expert child assessments when parents are under scrutiny. In matrimonial conflicts, police are urged to confirm relationships before making arrests. The court expressed concern over the rising incidents of false allegations in family disputes, highlighting the importance of in-depth investigations prioritizing children's welfare.

Yadav emphasized the importance of an alliance for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh elections based on winnability. He criticized the BJP for communal politics and promised various reforms if elected.

Asian Games: Seema, mixed relay win athletics medals; Roshibina bags Wushu silver
description: India enjoyed a strong medal-winning day at the Asian Games 2026, with Seema winning bronze in the women’s 10,000m and the mixed 4x400m relay team claiming silver. Seema’s medal was India’s first athletics medal at the Games and the country’s first women’s 10,000m medal since 2010. Roshibina Devi added another silver in the women’s 60kg sanda event, securing her second successive Asian Games silver and third overall medal at the continental showpiece.

title: 87-year-old’s eviction in Madrid sparks protests as Spain's housing crisis deepens
description: Maricarmen, an 87-year-old woman, faced eviction from her Madrid home after a significant rent increase. Her eviction sparked nationwide protests against rising housing costs and limited affordable options. The incident has intensified political debates just before the upcoming general election in Spain. Spain's government has proposed legislation to prevent similar evictions, but challenges remain due to a lack of parliamentary majority.

Mushtaq Khan, 'Welcome' and 'Gadar: Ek Prem Katha' actor, passes away at the age of 56
description: Mushtaq Khan, a celebrated Bollywood actor, sadly passed away on September 24 at Mumbai's Nanavati Hospital after a prolonged battle with cancer that began five years ago. His impressive legacy includes memorable performances in the 'Gadar' franchise and various television shows. Survived by his beloved wife and children, Khan leaves behind a rich artistic heritage that will be cherished by fans and colleagues alike.

description: On July 1, 2026, the homebuyer won the matter before the MahaREAT. In its ruling, the tribunal directed the builder to refund the homebuyer Rs 48.73 lakh and Rs 66.56 lakh, along with interest at the State Bank of India's Marginal Cost of Lending Rate (MCLR) plus 2%.

title: Did AI-‘kill chain’ lead to deadly Iran school strike? What report claims
description: A devastating missile strike by the US on a school in Minab, Iran, has led to the tragic loss of over 150 lives, including 123 innocent children. Investigations uncovered serious issues in the military’s targeting tactics, pointing to outdated intelligence and a lack of comprehensive civilian harm evaluations. The AI-powered Maven Smart System was crucial in target assessments.

How Iran’s rowers trained through war to win multiple Asian Games gold medals
description: Iran’s rowing team delivered a historic six-medal haul at the Asian Games in Nagoya after months of preparation disrupted by the Israel-Iran conflict. With athletes forced to train separately and indoors, Fatemeh Mojallal, Kimia Zarei and Zeinab Norouzi led the breakthrough, securing Iran’s first women’s rowing golds at the Games while the team added further silver and bronze medals.

title: Rahul attacks Centre over EC-SIR row; BJP calls it 'jooth ki goonj'
description: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has intensified accusations against the government and the Election Commission regarding electoral integrity. He demands the immediate resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, citing evidence of electoral manipulation. Concerns regarding unresolved objections from Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi further bolster his claims. The BJP has responded by rejecting his allegations and challenging his assertions about anti-incumbency.

title: Vithya Ramaraj turns on the afterburners; India storm to 4x400m silver at Asian Games
description: Manu kept India in the race before handing over to Vithya Ramaraj for the final leg. Vithya, known for her strong anchor legs, made up ground on the final lap and pulled India into second place to seal the silver.

title: California used 662,700 waste tires under I-880 ramp; no issues in 22 years
description: Engineers faced challenges while upgrading a highway interchange in Milpitas due to unstable bay mud. They opted to use shredded waste tires as lightweight fill to prevent ground settlement. This choice reduced weight on the soft soil by 40 percent and saved significant project costs. Over two decades, the infrastructure has shown no maintenance issues or structural damage.

title: 'No anti-incumbency against BJP?' Party counters Rahul with TN, Bengal poll history
Father's 'affairs', property fear: Why Kanpur millionaire's son ordered the hit job
description: Subrat Manocha has been arrested for allegedly plotting the murder of his father, Vineet Manocha, over financial concerns. The father was killed in his apartment in Kanpur, and investigations led to multiple arrests, including his daughter-in-law Shalu. Police have found evidence indicating Subrat's gambling debts and motive linked to his father's relationships. Initial plans to disguise the murder as accidental were abandoned as the plot unfolded.

title: IIT-B student suicide: Sahil Wakode’s parents begin hunger strike in Mumbai
description: Parents of Sahil Wakode, an IIT Bombay student who died by suicide, have started a hunger strike. They demand justice and action against those who allegedly tormented their son. The police have opened an investigation into his death, including examination of CCTV footage from the exam hall. Sahil faced allegations of caste discrimination during his studies at IIT Bombay.

description: Keightley had been appointed Mumbai Indians head coach in September 2025. The franchise confirmed her departure in a statement on Thursday.

title: From 33 to 12 hours, 14 to 6: Vande Bharat, roads cutting travel time drastically
description: Across bridges, tunnels, expressways and railways, projects are replacing long detours, difficult terrain and slower routes with more direct connections.

title: K'taka says ‘will release Cauvery water only if available’; TN flags 20 TMC deficit
description: Karnataka chief minister DK Shivakumar stated that water release depends on availability amid halted reservoir inflows. Tamil Nadu has requested its share of Cauvery water due to crop losses triggered by water shortages. The Supreme Court is reviewing Tamil Nadu's plea against Karnataka's claims of drought conditions. Karnataka previously released water despite facing harsh drought conditions and challenges in reservoir levels.

title: Florida land swap turns 4 Siesta Key beach lots public after decade of lawsuits
description: Michael Holderness bought four beachfront lots on Florida’s Siesta Key in 2016 and 2017, leading to years of disputes with Sarasota County over public access and development. Under a settlement, the county will receive the four lots and make them public beach property, while Holderness gets a nearby parcel valued at nearly $2.8 million, $500,000 and permission to build a 5,000-square-foot home.

title: Nokia closes China research hub; recalls CEO’s Huawei warning to Europe
description: Nokia is shutting its Hangzhou radio R&D centre in China by end-2026, cutting around 1,600 jobs, after its Greater China revenue fell over 58% since 2018. The closure revives CEO Justin Hotard's pointed question to Europe: why does Huawei still run nearly 60% of Germany's 5G sites while Nokia holds under 3% share in China? Restructuring charges have tripled to €800 million, even as AI and cloud orders surge 105%.

title: Jeff Bezos’ Earth Fund adds $25 million for Pacific Ocean conservation
description: The Bezos Earth Fund is allocating more than $25 million for ocean conservation projects in five Pacific nations. This funding will support various efforts: enhancing ocean management, establishing marine protected areas, and improving monitoring. The initiative aims to protect a significant portion of the ocean while promoting local leadership and community involvement. Additionally, international waters will also benefit from proposed marine protected areas.

title: Tom Brady reflects on difficult childhood and his children’s privileged lifestyle
description: Tom Brady, the New England Patriots’ legend, opens up about how his parents worked hard for him to make it in life.

title: Alonzo Mourning’s $37.4M affordable housing project offers $322 senior homes
description: After his NBA career, Alonzo Mourning founded AM Affordable Housing to address the pressing need for affordable homes in South Florida. Through collaboration with Housing Trust Group, he has spearheaded various projects, including the Astoria on 9th, which boasts 120 affordable apartments in Bradenton. With overwhelming demand and countless applicants vying for limited options, Mourning draws on his foster care history to fuel his philanthropic mission.
